goal: Audit PR637 for code complexity, duplication and performance
head: b1551b9c337c0c57dd21a4e2e26ccaff10fdfc93
tests_run: Static read-only source/diff review and compile-time layout checks only; no new simulations, runtime benchmarks or full suite reruns.

findings.title: One global error reduction per station per accepted endpoint
findings.evidence: Each station executes scalar host-result device reduction, MPI_Allreduce at159, count mirror at162 and compact-hit mirror at163. Empty ranks and no-hit intervals participate too. 16 stations imply 16 error collectives per observed endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Batch station validity into one collective per observation, then consider batched counts/transfers. Continue observing every accepted interval; do not optimize by dropping samples.
findings.phase: Dedicated performance follow-up, as previously agreed

findings.title: Full per-particle failure array allocated on every accelerating-PIC step
findings.evidence: Fresh default-initialized Diagnostic array every step; diagnostics(i)=diagnostic at1366 for successful particles too; host only reads on global failure and prints first record per rank. Diagnostic layout is64 bytes,16MiB for262144 local particles before allocation/initialization costs.
findings.recommendation: Reuse capacity-managed scratch storage; preferably retain one atomically selected first-failure record per rank and write only on failure, preserving collective failure propagation.

findings.title: Duplicated endpoint history costs160 bytes per station per allocated particle
findings.evidence: Two directed State records each hold the previous Endpoint; the same accepted endpoint is also duplicated across stations. All histories are registered migratable IPPL attributes. Local compile-time sizes verified: Endpoint56, directedState72, cyclotronState160, Hit96 bytes.
findings.recommendation: Future compact state: one migratable accepted endpoint per particle plus station-specific arming/passage information. Retain stable-ID association and out-of-line CUDA lifecycle ownership.
findings.phase: Dedicated performance follow-up, as previously agreed

findings.title: Cyclotron flush reduces every historical turn and rewrites unchanged summaries
findings.evidence: Flush every100 accepted global steps. Sink no-hit return does not skip subsequent summary work. One MPI_Reduce per turn0..maximumTurn, plus histogram reduction and full file replacement. maximumTurn200 means201 tiny peak reductions per station per flush. FFA radialSummaries=false correctly bypasses this branch.
findings.recommendation: Pack turn sums/counts into one array reduction and use globally agreed dirty state to skip unchanged summary rewrites. Preserve flush cadence and cumulative output semantics.

findings.title: Sector support predicate and coordinate calculations have two owners
findings.evidence: New DeviceField::add recomputes radius/angle/support at168..172, then shared cyclotron_field::field repeats it at59..63. Boundary rules could drift. Inlining may eliminate some redundant arithmetic; actual double-transcendental execution was not measured.
findings.recommendation: Let shared evaluator report support while accumulating B; forward its boolean from the descriptor. Preserve boundary and nonfinite-input semantics explicitly.

findings.title: RF transport dispatch repeats validation and contains dead guard
findings.evidence: Host/device branches repeat proton/spin/restart validation at1262 and1291. Nested cardinality rejection1255..1260 is unreachable because outer condition already proves those requirements. Immutable descriptor construction1300..1331 is inline in step routine.
findings.recommendation: Prepare/validate common RF capability once, remove dead guard, keep concise host/device step helpers within existing code. No additional tracker hierarchy.

findings.title: Lattice classification and gap collection repeatedly allocate sets and sort
findings.evidence: hasCyclotronGaps plus reference gap assembly1118..1132 existed in base; extension adds calls. OpalBeamline::getElements at89 reconstructs std::set by value. This is inherited debt amplified by PIC, not a newly introduced helper.
findings.recommendation: Cache immutable gap/sector occurrences during preparation, preserving current ordering.

findings.title: General adapter retains and copies whole files in memory
findings.evidence: Retains HDF5 batch DataFrames, concatenates, globally sorts and repeatedly validates/copies records. Ten64-bit columns alone cost80 bytes/hit;10million hits require800MB before copies, sorting and Python integer lists.
findings.recommendation: Consider an explicitly ordered batch-export mode and efficient typed integer validation when production analysis needs it. Streaming must not silently change documented global ordering.

recommendations: Three targeted cleanups (F2,F5,F6) before merge; retain F1/F3/F4 as explicit performance follow-ups and benchmark OFF/ON at representative N with1/4/16stations before throughput claims.
limitations: Structural costs and local ABI sizes are established; actual wall-clock slowdowns/speedups are unmeasured. Existing small GPU runs establish correctness, not representative beam-scale performance. No source fix, commit, push or GitHub review/comment made for audit.
next_step: Discuss audit and obtain task scope before implementing fixes.
